source_semantics.summary: The Site Settings toolbar exposes the localized Site dashboard and Connection center navigation actions for the currently loaded site.
source_semantics.canonical_collision_note: The source census parses both AppButton controls to the same canonical signature @(L.IsArabic ? -> @($, so this single canonical operation covers both source-equivalent toolbar destinations.
source_semantics.side_effect: Navigation only; no persistence, WordPress mutation, queue, cache or synthetic success state.

laravel_adaptation.site_dashboard_destination: canonical.site.details generated from the active tenant slug and authoritative tenant-owned site key
laravel_adaptation.connection_center_destination: /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site}/connection generated from the same active tenant/site context
laravel_adaptation.localization: English and Arabic labels follow the active Laravel locale
laravel_adaptation.read_authority: SiteSettingsReadController resolves the active TenantContext, requires tenant.view and sites.view, and loads the Site with an explicit active-tenant predicate before the links render.

state_and_security.loading_error_empty_authority: The toolbar is rendered only after the guarded Site Settings read succeeds; missing or foreign sites fail before rendering.
state_and_security.foreign_site: a site ID owned by another tenant returns 404

proofs: exact canonical operation identity remains PENDING in the immutable census input
both source toolbar destinations are represented by the one canonical collision signature
production markers exist only on the two Site Settings toolbar navigation links
href values derive from the active tenant and authoritative tenant-owned site key
English and Arabic labels preserve source intent
reading and rendering the links does not mutate site state
